items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: they got me to play because they knew I was sort of like a carbon copy of Earl on the piano

ctx.x: Well, Clarence Moore was his name, but they called him Eddie Moore, and he had a sub band when Earl Hines was so famous in those days from his broadcast, he'd go on the road, and they got me to play because they knew I was sort of like a carbon copy of Earl on the piano. Because I sounded like Earl.
